name: center-imagemasking
title: Center Splash Image Mask
blurb: Image masked with a center splash shape.
description: Renders an image clipped to a center splash/radial shape using CSS mask-image. Full height, responsive.
use_when: Hero image sections, artistic layouts, or background images with organic shapes.
avoid_when: Browsers lacking mask-image support (IE); content requiring edge visibility.
a11y: Static image element with alt text. Mask is decorative.
